tier_compliance.reason: “Notice ... larger” asks the student to observe one visual detail, without explaining a concept or giving a reasoning procedure.

visual_grounding.reason: “The magnets in Pair 1” and “those in Pair 2” identify the specific objects being compared.

unsupported_claims: “The magnets in Pair 1 are larger than those in Pair 2.” The corresponding magnets appear the same size in both pairs.

scientific_correctness.reason: The hint makes no scientific claim linking size to magnetic force; its inaccurate size comparison is a visual error.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: Emphasizing supposedly larger magnets in Pair 1 directs attention toward greater force in Pair 1, whereas the smaller separation makes Pair 2 correct.

answer_disclosure.reason: It does not state a force comparison or explain how the claimed size difference would determine an option.

actionability.reason: “Notice” gives an immediate, specific comparison of the magnets in the two labeled pairs, although that comparison is inaccurate.
